turns.message: I placed an online order on FirstCry.com on December 1, 2024 for a children's tricycle and paid ₹2,130.06. The very next day the company cancelled the order without giving any reason or notice, and the amount was not refunded. When I contacted customer care, they told me the amount had been adjusted against a previous order from 2023, claiming a wrong product had been returned in that order. That earlier return was accepted and refunded after their own warehouse check. They have now flagged me as a "fraud user" without any notice or proof.

expected.rationale: Refund not received, exact purchase date, customer care contacted, grievance officer not mentioned.
